assumptions.random_generator: NumPy default_rng; seed numbers not provided by paper, fixed to 0..9 before runs
assumptions.endpoints: [-4,-4] -> [4,3], inferred from unlabelled Fig.6; numeric endpoints not published
assumptions.robot: point implemented as 1e-6 m sphere; analytic checks use obstacle_radius + point_radius
assumptions.limits_and_degree: unit velocity/acceleration and degree 6, matching released Kinova example; simulation values not stated
assumptions.LSCS_solver: Clarabel substitutes for unavailable MOSEK license; same SOCP objective and constraints
assumptions.LGCS_solver: Gurobi Python MISOCP with bounded big-M flow; same convex-set graph path objective, not Drake's unavailable Gurobi binding
assumptions.roadmap: released CSDecomp RoadmapBuilder and DrmPlanner; Forest circles in static scene per environment seed; no perception/IK needed in 2D
assumptions.validation: exact line-circle closest distances for polygonal paths; derivative-controlled dense sampling for splines; not continuous certification
assumptions.unpublished_settings: NTO time uses at least 8 controls (4 controls plus rest endpoints forces a straight line); both NTO variants use a 0.01 m collocation clearance to avoid numerical tangencies. These settings are not specified in the paper; no equality with published success rates is claimed.
assumptions.nto_warm_start: PWL warm start resampled to at least 8 time controls, with repeated first/last controls to satisfy standstill. Nc is unchanged; nearest uniform collocation locations are snapped to internal spline knots to avoid leaving PWL vertices unchecked. Original code/locations not released.
assumptions.recovery_limit: 20 iterations, from the released example; paper does not state a maximum
